attchmntText: The Andhra Sugars Limited has informed the Exchange about Closure of operations
voiceSummary: The Andhra Sugars Limited Board of Directors approved the closure of its Sugar Unit at Bhimadole and Sulphuric Acid Unit at Kovvur on 7th November 2026. Operations for both units will cease effective 01.10.2026. The Bhimadole Sugar Unit reported a loss of Rs. 731.08 Lakhs in 2025-26, representing 6.44% of the company's total profit. The Kovvur Sulphuric Acid Unit reported a profit of Rs. 402.00 Lakhs, contributing 3.54% to the total profit. The closure of the Bhimadole unit is due to the plant being over 60 years old and the expansion of similar facilities elsewhere. The Kovvur unit closure is attributed to the non-availability of cane over recent seasons. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations.

attchmntText: The Andhra Sugars Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Outcome of the Board Meeting'.
voiceSummary: The Board of Directors of The Andhra Sugars Limited approved the Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 on 7 November 2026. The company reported a profit for the period of Rs. 2526.67 lakhs, compared to Rs. 3100.21 lakhs in the same period last year. Revenue from operations stood at Rs. 39631.24 lakhs. Earnings per share from continuing and discontinued operations was Rs. 1.86. The increase in profit is attributed to higher selling prices of Chemical Products. Discontinued operations include the Sugar unit, Power generation unit at Tanuku, and Wind Power unit at Ramagiri. The Board meeting commenced at 11:25 a.m. and concluded at 2:26 p.m.
